topics.title: Getting started
topics.summary: New here? Start with this page. It shows the first steps, a simple daily routine, and what every menu item is for.

topics.title: Dashboard
topics.summary: Your home page. See how your shop is doing and what needs your attention today.

topics.title: Orders
topics.summary: Everything buyers order from you. Accept it, pack it, send it, and keep track of the money.

topics.title: My products
topics.summary: Your shop window. Add your birds and items, set prices and stock, and keep every detail correct.

topics.title: Payments
topics.summary: The list of all money received for your orders. Use it to check who paid, how much, and when.

topics.title: Paid requests
topics.summary: A buyer of a cash on delivery order says "I already paid." You check the proof and decide.

topics.title: Payment accounts
topics.summary: The bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay or bank accounts where buyers send you money.

topics.title: Returns
topics.summary: A buyer received an order and wants to send something back. You decide, and if you say yes, you return the money.

topics.title: Refunds
topics.summary: When an order that was already paid is cancelled, the buyer must get their money back. This page is where you do it and prove it.

topics.title: Price offers
topics.summary: A buyer says "I will pay this price." You can say yes, suggest another price, or say no.

topics.title: Questions
topics.summary: Buyers ask about your birds on the product page. Your answer is public, so every buyer can read it.

topics.title: Reviews
topics.summary: What buyers say about your birds. Read every review and reply, because everyone can see your replies.

topics.title: Wishlist
topics.summary: Buyers can save a product to buy later. This page shows how many people saved yours.

topics.title: Reports
topics.summary: Numbers about your shop for the days you choose. Read them on the screen or download them for Excel.

topics.title: Statements
topics.summary: One page for one month: what you sold, what the marketplace kept, what you paid and what you owe.

topics.title: System commission
topics.summary: The fee the marketplace keeps from each sale. See your rate, what you owe and what you paid.

topics.title: My profile
topics.summary: Your shop details, your documents, your password, and the switch that opens or closes your shop.
